definition: the case I use to bound what my thin data actually costs me

settled:
It usually doesn't matter if I can't remember what color the floor is in a room. That kind of failure isn't very central to truth, so there isn't much loss there.

That is the bound on the thin half. The particulars I drop are mostly not the sort of thing a true model rests on, which is why the gap does not read as a general blindness.
